verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for an online business-filing service, since such services can offer APIs or bulk-data access. The evidence documents only interactive web workflows (Annual Report Wizard, online filing, entity search), and probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or documented public API. A keyless GET to the portal root shows only that the site is reachable, not that it supports headless or CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
